_comment: One source of truth for what each Codex failure is CALLED, so the two platforms cannot drift into telling the same user two different stories. 'windows' is the widget's one-line status text (widget.ps1); 'mac' is the menu row (mac/moth.5m.sh). They differ in length because one is a status line and the other is a menu row - they must never differ in meaning. Both test suites assert against this file.

interpreter-missing.mac: Found the Codex CLI, but not the interpreter it needs (install Node, or use the app's own build).

quarantine.mac: macOS blocked it. Run it once from a terminal, or clear quarantine: xattr -d com.apple.quarantine <path>

parse-fail.windows: Codex reply had no usable limits
parse-fail.mac: Codex replied, but with no usable limits.

exited.mac: The Codex CLI exited before answering.

rpc-auth.windows: sign in to Codex to sync
rpc-auth.mac: Sign in to Codex to sync.

rpc-too-old.mac: This Codex build is too old to report rate limits.

rpc-overloaded.mac: Codex is overloaded - try again shortly.
